lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::github computes a pull request s mergestatestatus lazily and can answer unknown right after a push a proof reading it must retry until it settles
lessons.text: GitHub computes a pull request's mergeStateStatus lazily and can answer UNKNOWN right after a push; a proof reading it must retry until it settles.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a criterion names several file kinds ts and tsx the proof must exercise each kind not just one
lessons.text: When a criterion names several file kinds (.ts and .tsx), the proof must exercise each kind, not just one.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::prove a table exists by querying the schema not by a command that exits 0 when the table is absent
lessons.text: Prove a table exists by querying the schema, not by a command that exits 0 when the table is absent

lessons.key: spec_deviation::get user confirmation before a check asserts a command or name different from the literal the binding spec gives
lessons.text: Get user confirmation before a check asserts a command or name different from the literal the binding spec gives

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a screen renders the same control in two places desktop nav and a phone menu dialog assert the per control metric in both placements and read sizes only after the dialog s open animation settles
lessons.text: When a screen renders the same control in two places (desktop nav and a phone menu Dialog), assert the per-control metric in both placements, and read sizes only after the Dialog's open animation settles.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::a no secret in source check must name the file set its proof scans git tracked or would track because the ignored env local is where the secret is meant to live
lessons.text: A 'no secret in source' check must name the file set its proof scans (git-tracked or would-track), because the ignored .env.local is where the secret is meant to live.

lessons.key: gate_fail::pin generated files to lf in gitattributes because git for windows defaults core autocrlf true and a regenerated output is clean check then fails on identical bytes
lessons.text: Pin generated files to LF in .gitattributes, because Git for Windows defaults core.autocrlf=true and a 'regenerated output is clean' check then fails on identical bytes.

lessons.key: gate_fail::write tr d r as an escape never a literal control character editors and scripted edits turn a raw cr into an lf
lessons.text: Write tr -d '\r' as an escape, never a literal control character: editors and scripted edits turn a raw CR into an LF.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::a proof that a build fails must grep the expected error in the output not only check the exit code
lessons.text: A proof that a build fails must grep the expected error in the output, not only check the exit code.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::a no focus trap assertion must check where focus ends up body or back to the first element not just that focus took more than one value
lessons.text: A no-focus-trap assertion must check where focus ends up (body or back to the first element), not just that focus took more than one value.
